structured_output.body:
# Linux test checks

Never run `swift test` on the Mac to verify Linux behaviour. It tests macOS, not Linux, and gives misleading results.

## Do this
- Run the whole Linux suite: `./scripts/test-linux.sh`
- Run a subset: `./scripts/test-linux.sh --filter <TestClassOrName>`

## Known failure
`error: XCTestCase subclass marked @MainActor isn't discovered on Linux: 0 tests run`
- This means the Linux run found no tests. It is not a pass.
- Check whether the test class is marked `@MainActor`. Linux XCTest does not discover such classes.
- Fix it by moving the `@MainActor` annotation off the class and onto the individual test methods or the code they call. Then re-run `./scripts/test-linux.sh --filter <name>`.

## Rules
- Treat "0 tests run" as a failure and never report it as success.
- Report the Linux result from `./scripts/test-linux.sh` only, not from a local `swift test`.
